input.note: Uploaded manifest/report were analyzed outside GitHub; raw manifest and report are not committed here.

method: Least-squares fit for 3-vector camera rotation, camera translation and 3-vector link-frame marker center offset, using best IPPE solution tvec and URDF FK. Uses marker center positions ONLY; no marker orientation; uses recorded LeRobot angles as URDF angles directly. Fit is nonlinear 9-parameter and not independent absolute validation.

sign_sensitivity.tested: 16 sign combinations for J1..J4, with remaining quantities fit freely
sign_sensitivity.best: all signs positive, corresponding to using recorded angles directly
sign_sensitivity.warning: Sign sweep does not verify encoder joint zero offset or the exact physical mounting link.

additional_findings.warning: ID4 appears in similar image region across poses, but no independently verified stationary mount; this span alone is not a static-marker accuracy estimate.

next_steps: Reopen original per-pose PNG images and refine integer-pixel ArUco corners with subpixel detection; rerun PnP before making 3D accuracy conclusions.
Use same-frame fixed reference marker when physically confirmed stationary to estimate depth stability and possible camera/OBS changes.
Confirm ID2 is rigidly affixed to wrist_link rather than a J5-dependent link, and check LeRobot-URDF zero offsets.
Validate side OBS pixel geometry against ChArUco sessions and original ArUco recording.
Only after errors are understood, fit a full robust eye-to-hand model including two IPPE orientations and heldout poses.
